■Stage Direction
1 second silence at start

...It really was just as I had heard. Flawless commitment to her training.
Yet, despite that, lackluster results. And—
No.

"So I arranged mock races at longer distances around 1,600m to 1,800m
to train her... but the results weren't great."

...I was planning to go for a walk.
...Why do you ask?

...I don't really understand.
For what purpose?

That's right~, we just wanted to talk. About that girl you were
concerned about as well—Believe.
I mean—it's your day off too, isn't it?
—Um.
...I need to get faster. Faster, even faster—

I fell in love with that talent once, and I refuse to let it go to waste.
That's why I'm talking to you like this.

One day, I was invited to the camp's wrap-up party held at a reserved restaurant,
where I found myself surrounded by a multitude of veteran Trainers—

The veterans naturally possess superior technical expertise. So rather than that,
what could I, a rookie Trainer, do for her—yes, for instance...
I want to become faster.

Something only a total rookie like me could do—someone who doesn't
manage a massive team and can build a relationship one-on-one—

"Normally, from there, we'd compare notes with her own intuition
and feel things out to find her true aptitudes, but—"
I want to become faster. ...That is my top priority.

Even as I answer, a nagging thought echoes in my mind...
I recall what the veteran trainers told me the other day.

...I will hone my craft further.
Please allow me to increase my independent training volume.

No, it's not really a nuisance...
......

There are things only you can do—the one who is drawn to her right now.
...Will you help her? Our promising rookie Trainer.
............Um, that is all.

Running is my job.
Therefore, the poor performance was entirely my responsibility.

...Her work ethic in training is flawless. You saw it during the camp, didn't you?
Very few girls possess such pure, single-minded dedication.

What do you say, won't you take up the torch?
You've been curious about Believe too, haven't you?

...To put it bluntly.
Would you be willing to look after Believe?
It's not... fun, probably.

...Are you nervous? Haha, you really wear your heart on your sleeve, don't you?
Don't look so stiff. It's not like we've cornered you to scold you.

I have completed warm-ups.
Awaiting menu instructions.
Huh?
Yes.

It's just that she's almost too single-minded, or rather... Well.
She never voices an opinion, let alone a complaint. Not a single word.
This coming day off...?

Truth is, each of us entered a provisional contract with her once.
Yet none of us... could manage to guide her properly.

None of us could draw out her true feelings.
Honestly, that hurts our pride. ...Yet more than that,

Haah, haah, haah, haah...!
...Gh—!!

...I apologize.
I finished 8th in the mock race.

—Today as well, Believe continues to train with utter devotion, exactly
according to my instructions. Watching her, I reflect on those words.

"Her running style somehow reminds me of Bubblegum Fellow,
who made their mark in the classic middle-distance division."

Ah... Trainer.
I will be in your care for the provisional contract starting today.
